response.sql: WITH c AS (SELECT ID, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM Examination GROUP BY ID), t AS (SELECT CAST(SUM(cnt) AS REAL) AS total, COUNT(*) AS n FROM c), s AS (SELECT c.ID, c.cnt, c.cnt / t.total AS share, 1.0 / t.n AS avg_share FROM c, t) SELECT ID, cnt AS num_examinations, share, share - avg_share AS margin_above_average FROM s WHERE share > avg_share ORDER BY margin_above_average DESC LIMIT 10
